content.text: You'll set up a database, write an Express server, implement CRUD endpoints, and deploy.
This assignment lets you choose between two database stacks:
— A relational database with a modern type-safe ORM. Prisma generates a client from a schema file and handles migrations. This is the same stack you used in SA: Wordle API.
— A document database with an ODM (Object-Document Mapper). Mongoose defines schemas in JavaScript and stores data as flexible JSON-like documents.
Both paths produce the same API. Your frontend doesn't care which database backs it — it sends and receives the same JSON either way.
